An absolute unit of a tower with unmatched firepower, supportive capabilities, and boss destruction.|Store Description}} {{QuoteBox|A single tower with high single target damage capabilities and the potential for some defensive utility for nearby towers.|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Juggernaut''' or '''EvolvedJuggernaut''' is the [[Tower Evolution|evolved]] version of the [[Minigunner]], unlocked by reaching Level 20 on the [[Minigunner]] tower, either by getting the experience or by skipping the need to get it by paying {{Robux|599}}. Once done, it can be bought for {{Gem|6,000}} and {{Coins|15,000}}. As it is an evolved tower, only some of its upgrades are unlocked at the start. All other have to be unlocked by reaching higher [[Tower Evolution|evolution levels]] on the tower. The '''Juggernaut''' starts out working very similarly to the [[Minigunner]]. When enemies enter its range, it will rev up its minigun and start firing at them. It will not differ mechanically until Level 4, where it gains two paths. #The top path is a more support based path where it gains a secondary range in which it reduces stun, freeze and debuff durations. Any tower in that range will have orange shields around them. #The bottom path is more offensive based as it gives the passive ability of dealing boosted damage to [[Boss]] enemies. The '''Juggernaut''' has hidden detection from Level 2, flying detection from Level 4A and lead detection from Level 4B. }} == Strategy == *The '''Juggernaut''' is best utilized as a mid-to-late game tower. *The '''Juggernaut''', due to having the highest placement and upgrade costs, is impractical for easier gamemodes with a lower number of waves such as [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] and [[Casual Mode|Casual]]. **Economy towers, such as the [[Farm]], [[Cowboy]] and [[Kingpin]] (top path) can aid in the its extremely expensive upgrades. **The [[DJ Booth]]'s ''Green Track'' can also significantly aid in its extremely expensive upgrades, with the [[DJ Booth]] itself being an economy tower itself through its ''Drop The Beat'' ability through its ''Green Track''. *As it has a placement limit of one and an extremely large placement footprint, consider placing it where its range will cover most of the path. *At Level 3, the '''Juggernaut''' gains two paths: **The top path is focused on reducing the stun or debuff times of towers caused by enemies' abilities, such as the [[Necrotic Skeleton]]'s ''Gooey Demise'', or the [[Fallen King]]'s ''Sword Swing''. ***This is particularly useful for reducing the downtime of towers by reducing the stun and debuff durations of them. ****This is best utilized if the tower is already surrounded by other towers. *****Note that this is not as effective if it is not surrounded by enough towers, usually behind or in front of where most of the towers are placed. ***This path also gains flying detection, being useful for dealing with high health flying enemies like the [[Fallen Seraph]], [[Balloon Kid]], [[Voodoo Doll]] and [[Fallen Angel]]. ****Despite the fact that this path is only slightly cheaper than bottom path for flying detection, costing a total of around {{Money|72,000}}, this should not be much of a concern, as it is possible to get a Level 4A+ Juggernaut before Wave 22 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode and before Wave 28 in [[Pizza Party]]. **The bottom path is focused on dealing extra DPS to enemies with the [[Boss]] attribute via a damage multiplier. ***Note that the damage multiplier does not apply to enemies without the [[Boss]] attribute, but this still deals more DPS to enemies in general companed to the top path. ****This is best utilized for aiding in the defeat of [[Boss]] enemies, such as the [[Fallen Honor Guard]] and [[Executioner (Pizza Party)|Executioner]], as well as final boss enemies such as the [[Fallen King]], [[Frost Spirit]], and [[Wox the Fox]]. ***Although this path gains [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] detection, it is impractical for gamemodes that introduce enemies that have the [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] attribute early on, such as [[Pizza Party]], costing a total of {{Money|77,000}} just to get the detection. ==Trivia== *The '''Juggernaut''' was originally intended to release alongside the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] as an evolved counterpart to the [[Minigunner]], but would be cut for undisclosed reasons, likely due to time constraints. *The '''Juggernaut''' tower is the most expensive tower in the game's history, regardless of whether the player uses the top or bottom path, costing a total of {{Money|532,000}} to completely max out the tower if on the bottom path, or {{Money|400,200}} otherwise, followed by the [[Gatling Gun]]. **Although, if developer-exclusive towers are counted, the [[Golden Snowballer]] is more expensive overall, costing {{Money|1,002,609}} in total. *The '''Juggernaut''' is the first tower to cost both {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Gem|Gems}} simultaneously. *The '''Juggernaut''' is the first tower to have seven upgrades. *The '''Juggernaut''' is the first tower to evolve from one another—in which this tower is evolved from the [[Minigunner]]—followed by the [[Operator]] which is evolved from the [[Scout]]. *The orange shield seen around towers in '''Juggernaut's''' ''Fortify'' range may be a reference to the [[Shield]] seen on certain enemies prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. *The '''Juggernaut's''' quote in Experimental Weaponry is likely a reference to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EzWNBmjyv7Y Thanos in the end credits scene for the ''Age of Ultron'']. *The '''Juggernaut's''' final upgrades
